theme: Apartment residents' shared move-out clean-up: offers, commitments, cancellations and handovers

messages.author: u-greta
messages.text: Hi neighbours, shared clean-up of the stairwell and bike room before move-out: Sunday 8 June, 2pm. Who can help?

messages.author: u-sami
messages.text: I'll bring the vacuum and an extension cord.

messages.author: u-ola
messages.text: I can do the bike room sweep.

messages.author: u-fenn
messages.text: I'll bring bin bags and gloves for everyone.

messages.author: u-nadia
messages.text: I could probably bring a ladder for the light fittings, not 100% sure yet.

messages.author: u-luca
messages.text: I'll book the bulky-waste pickup with the council for Monday 9 June.

messages.author: u-greta
messages.text: Perfect, thanks Luca.

messages.author: u-sami
messages.text: Sorry, cancelling the vacuum offer, mine just broke.

messages.author: u-ola
messages.text: I'll bring my vacuum then. Sami, can you take the bins out instead?

messages.author: u-sami
messages.text: Deal, I'll take the bins out after.

messages.author: u-fenn
messages.text: Who has the key to the bike room?

messages.author: u-nadia
messages.text: Confirmed: I'm bringing the ladder.

messages.author: u-luca
messages.text: Update: the council moved the bulky-waste pickup to Tuesday 10 June.

messages.author: u-greta
messages.text: Ola, since you're on vacuum now, can someone else take the bike room?

messages.author: u-fenn
messages.text: I'll sweep the bike room. Handing over the bin bags and gloves to Nadia, she has spares from her own move.

messages.author: u-nadia
messages.text: Yes, I'll bring bags and gloves.

messages.author: u-luca
messages.text: Caretaker has the bike room key, I'll pick it up Saturday.

messages.author: u-greta
messages.text: Time change: we'll start at 3pm because of the building's water shutoff. Date stays the same.

messages.author: u-ola
messages.text: Stairwell windows, anyone?

messages.author: u-sami
messages.text: I can do them if I'm back from my parents in time, otherwise no.

messages.author: u-fenn
messages.text: Instead of buying cleaning spray, I've got a big bottle left over, I'll bring that.

messages.author: u-luca
messages.text: Bad news, I'm away that weekend after all. Can someone pick up the bike room key Saturday instead of me?

messages.author: u-greta
messages.text: I'll get the key from the caretaker Saturday.

messages.author: u-nadia
messages.text: Who is doing what again? Losing track.

messages.author: u-greta
messages.text: Vacuum Ola, bins Sami, bike room Fenn, bags/gloves and ladder Nadia, key me. Luca booked the bulky-waste pickup.

messages.author: u-ola
messages.text: Should we tell the landlord about the clean-up?

messages.author: u-sami
messages.text: See you Sunday at 3.

state.note: One-detail correction: only the time changes (2pm -> 3pm). The date Sunday 8 June still comes from s3m01, so s3m01 is superseded for time only.
Sami cancels (s3m08), Ola takes over (s3m09). The takeover is an ownership handover, not a separate pair.
Ola moved to vacuum (s3m14 request), Fenn takes the bike room.
Fenn hands over to Nadia; s3m16 is Nadia accepting.
Tentative offer ('probably, not 100% sure') replaced by a firm commitment.
Here 'Update' IS a correction (Monday 9 -> Tuesday 10 June). Luca remains the booker.
Luca withdraws (s3m22), Greta takes over (s3m23, handover). Bins (s3m10) and cleaning spray (s3m21, non-correcting 'Instead') are additive. s3m20 is a conditional that is never confirmed.

questions.question: Who is bringing the vacuum?
questions.goldAnswer: Ola. Sami cancelled because his vacuum broke.

questions.question: Is Sami still bringing the vacuum?
questions.goldAnswer: No. He cancelled because it broke; Ola is bringing hers and Sami takes the bins out instead.

questions.question: Who is sweeping the bike room?
questions.goldAnswer: Fenn took it over after Ola switched to bringing the vacuum.

questions.question: Does the clean-up still start at 2pm?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Greta moved the start to 3pm because of the water shutoff; the date stays the same.
questions.note: One-detail correction. textMustNot left empty because a correct answer may echo the question's '2pm'.

questions.question: When is the bulky-waste pickup?
questions.goldAnswer: Tuesday 10 June, booked with the council by Luca.

questions.question: Who is picking up the bike room key?
questions.goldAnswer: Greta, from the caretaker on Saturday. Luca withdrew because he is away that weekend.
questions.note: Delayed answer later withdrawn and taken over.

questions.question: Is Sami definitely doing the stairwell windows?
questions.goldAnswer: No. Only if he is back from his parents in time, and that was never confirmed.

questions.question: Who is bringing bin bags and gloves?
questions.goldAnswer: Nadia; Fenn handed that over to her.

questions.question: Has anyone told the landlord about the clean-up?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Ola asked whether to tell the landlord, but nobody replied.

questions.question: Who is mopping the lobby floor?
questions.goldAnswer: Unknown. Mopping the lobby was never discussed; the clean-up covers the stairwell and bike room.
